name: daily_stock_analysis
description: LLM 驱动的多市场股票智能分析系统：多源行情、实时新闻、决策看板与自动推送，支持零成本定时运行。 LLM-powered multi-market stock analysis system with multi-source market data, real-time news, decision dashboard, automated notifications, and cost-free scheduled runs.
one_liner: A free, automated system that reads stock news and prices every day and pushes a plain-language 'should I buy or sell' report straight to your phone or chat app.
buyer: A part-time retail investor in Asia who wants a daily AI-generated watchlist report without paying for an expensive trading terminal.
business_use_cases: A part-time trader deploys it for free on GitHub Actions and gets a daily WeChat-delivered dashboard with buy/sell signals before the market opens.
An investment newsletter writer uses its daily output as the backend for a rebranded 'today's picks' report sent to a paid subscriber list.
A fintech tutor builds a paid course teaching retail investors how to deploy and customize this system for their own stock watchlist.

money_ideas.idea: Paid 'set it up for you' service configuring a custom watchlist and notification channel
Subscription tip-sheet newsletter that repackages its daily output with added commentary

steal_this: Deploy it for a friend's five favorite stocks on GitHub Actions, then repackage the daily push as a cheap paid tip-sheet for a niche trading community.
